title: rosa mollis f. patula
intro: Rosa mollis f. patula, commonly known as a fragrant or sweet rose, is a type of flowering plant in the rose family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Rosa mollis f. patula include antiseptic, antiviral, and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help soothe skin irritations and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
